# Didian

> AI resource workbench — from browser tabs to structured, searchable, deduplicated resource libraries.

Didian captures what you find in the browser before it disappears into downloads and bookmarks, dispatches it to a local AI agent runtime, and turns it into a structured, searchable, and traceable resource library — with human confirmation at every write step.

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/didian-ai/didian.git
cd didian
pnpm install
cp .env.example .env
make setup
make start
```

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend:** React 19, Next.js 16, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4
- **Desktop:** Electron
- **Mobile:** Expo / React Native
- **Backend:** Go 1.26, Chi router, sqlc, gorilla/websocket
- **Database:** PostgreSQL
- **State:** TanStack Query 5, Zustand 5
- **Extension:** Chrome Extension (MV3)
- **Adapters:** Mock Drive, Local Drive, cloud-drive interfaces

## Project Structure

```
didian/
├── apps/web/           # Next.js App Router platform
├── apps/extension/     # Chrome extension — passive browser capture
├── apps/desktop/       # Electron desktop app
├── apps/mobile/        # Expo / React Native (iOS)
├── server/             # Go API, task queue, WebSocket, daemon
├── packages/core/      # Headless logic, schemas, API client, stores
├── packages/ui/        # Reusable UI primitives
├── packages/views/     # Shared product views
├── packages/adapters/  # Drive adapter implementations
└── tasks/              # Implementation plan and checklist
```

## Key Concepts

- **AI Inbox** — Capture browser tabs, links, and downloads into resource tasks with full provenance
- **Mission** — A resource task routed to a local Agent runtime with inspectable execution steps
- **Atlas Workspace** — Structured, searchable, deduplicated resource library with agent-generated artifacts
- **Local Daemon** — Detects Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, and OpenCode from PATH; runs agents in isolated workdirs
- **Human Confirmation Gate** — Review every proposed action before writing to the drive workspace
- **Adapter-based Drive** — MockDriveAdapter for MVP; clean interface for local folder, cloud-drive, or MCP adapters
